notes: Community coverage is marked insufficient because the 10-K covers external community investment only as a governance oversight topic (charitable contributions, community reinvestment) and refers readers to the website and 2025 Annual Report for human capital details, so this triggers the automated sustainability-report second look. The filing does not describe the focus or membership groups of the 11 Employee Networks, only that they are open to all employees and fall under the Talent, Inclusion and Opportunity heading. Score 3 follows the rubric's treatment of employee networks with membership figures and should be confirmed in the second look. Excluded as traps or non-activities: 'Community Reinvestment Act ratings' (regulatory eligibility condition), 'Government and public education' (a credit exposure category), cybersecurity training for employees (compliance-type training), 'Risk Framework serves as the foundation' (not a charitable foundation), and international operations. The small business loan table units are not shown in the excerpt. Minimum wage, healthcare premiums, counseling and sabbatical benefits are current employee benefits but do not meet any theme's criteria.
